design_plan: Python RNG Execution: seed derived from title + niche_landing + busy executives + generated_at to select architecture. Chosen hero architecture: editorial-split. AIDA Check: Hero (Attention), proof and comparisons (Interest), workflow video and guide (Desire), CTA band (Action). Font Selection: Cabinet Grotesk for headlines, system UI for body. Hero Math Verification: clamp-based H1 sized to fit 2–3 lines at 1200px width. Bento Density Verification: grid-auto-flow: dense applied in bento and compare sections. GSAP Motion Selection: image-scale-fade-scroll and hover-physics. Label Sweep & Button Check: all CTAs use black pill primary and high-contrast secondary buttons.
